dedupe_keys.name: icasa data standards and master variable list for agricultural field experiments and crop modelling icasa dictionary

description: Data standards for describing agricultural field experiments and production so that data can be shared between crop models, databases and analysis tools. The DSSAT standards page says the standards began with the IBSNAT project, were revised by ICASA, and were extended in Version 2.0 (White et al., 2013, Computers and Electronics in Agriculture) to cover tillage, mulches and more soil and plant traits, with a hierarchical master list of variables for management practices or treatments, soil and weather conditions and measured crop responses, a plain text format and other digital implementations. Since Version 2.0 the list is updated continuously on GitHub (DSSAT/ICASA-Dictionary), where it can be viewed and downloaded, while the earlier master variable list stays online for compatibility; Cheryl Porter and Jeff White are the curators. An ICASA Excel data template (version 4.01, October 2023, by Pierre Martre, INRAE) is on Zenodo as a downloadable XLSX of 0.9 MB under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is any crop experiment. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): BSD-3-Clause. For simulation it is the common input format that lets weather, soil and management data move between DSSAT, AgMIP tools and other crop models. Related catalogue records include DSSAT and GGCMI outputs. The underlying files were not downloaded, so their contents are not verified here.
